about: What the video says, line by line. `pnpm voice` turns each line into one audio clip (ElevenLabs, with timestamps) and writes src/data/narration.json with its length and word timings, so the subtitles land on the word. `say`, when present, is the spelling the voice reads; the screen shows `text`, and both have the same number of words. Figures: hub, zones, fleet, stops per route and the KPI baseline (361 min) and target (330 min) come from the company profile, generated with AI from prompt 001 and validated against OpenStreetMap (services/generator/seed/company.json); they are a baseline and a target, not results. 5 s GPS, 5 min traffic and hourly weather are the platform's design (docs/phases/1-case.md). 1.8 GB for the nine services was measured on 28 September 2026 (README). The vans are simulated on real roads; the GPS simulator, the optimizer and the KPI dashboard arrive at milestones M2 (5 October) and M3 (8 October).

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Half past seven, Zona Franca.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Thirty vans leave the Llobregat Express hub with about seventy stops each, in a fixed order.
lines.say: Thirty vans leave the Yoo-bruh-gat Express hub with about seventy stops each, in a fixed order.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: By eleven, that order is wrong.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A car sits in the loading bay. The Ronda Litoral jams at Glòries. It starts to rain. Nobody answers the door in the Raval.
lines.say: A car sits in the loading bay. The Ronda Lee-to-rahl jams at Glo-ree-es. It starts to rain. Nobody answers the door in the Rah-vahl.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every delay pushes every later stop further back, and the plan made at dawn never finds out.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: So we measure one thing, the way the company would: the average delivery time per route.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: From the moment a van leaves the hub, to its last delivery.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The company's baseline is six hours and one minute. Its target is five and a half.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Llobregat Express is the data platform behind that number, running end to end.
lines.say: Yoo-bruh-gat Express is the data platform behind that number, running end to end.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every van sends its position every five seconds.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The city publishes the state of its roads every five minutes. The weather, every hour.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Fast signals stream through Redpanda; slow ones arrive in batches.
lines.say: Fast signals stream through Red-panda; slow ones arrive in batches.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Both land in TimescaleDB, raw first, then cleaned by dbt, then shaped into the KPI.
lines.say: Both land in Timescale-D-B, raw first, then cleaned by D-B-T, then shaped into the K-P-I.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Dagster runs the schedule, and Grafana shows it live.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Here is one ping. Van seven, six kilometres an hour, on the Ronda Litoral.
lines.say: Here is one ping. Van seven, six kilometres an hour, on the Ronda Lee-to-rahl.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Joined to the road, it becomes information: the van has been crawling for nine minutes.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Against the history, it becomes knowledge: this stretch jams on weekday mornings.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And then it becomes an action.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The optimizer re-orders the fourteen stops van seven has left, on real road times, before it reaches the jam.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A navigation app finds the fastest way from one address to the next.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It does not decide which van carries which parcel, keep two-hour delivery windows, or move stops from a late van to an early one.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And it cannot tell you how long your routes really took yesterday. Only your own data can.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: We plan the day of a fleet, not the trip of a driver, and we measure whether it worked.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Every number traces back to its source, with who owns it and when it arrived.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Traffic, weather and roads are real, open data.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The company itself is generated with AI, and every prompt is published and checked against the real map.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The whole platform starts with one command, in under two gigabytes of memory, and every change is tested by booting it from scratch.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Llobregat Express. Thirty vans, one city that keeps changing, and routes that change with it.
lines.say: Yoo-bruh-gat Express. Thirty vans, one city that keeps changing, and routes that change with it.
